summary: An 8-voice virtual analog synth modelled on the Roland SH-101 and S-1, with a two-track step sequencer. It also runs on M-VAVE's SMK-37 keyboards.
features: Mono, unison, poly and chord modes; saw, pulse/PWM, sub and noise
'OSC DRAW' 16-step wavetables and 'OSC CHOP' comb overtones
24 dB/oct filter with self-oscillation; LFO up to audio rate
Two 64-step polyphonic tracks with ratchets, probability, motion recording
64 factory programs, 35 user slots, 8 patterns; arpeggiator with hold
USB audio and USB MIDI with the S-1 CC map and SysEx patch dump

headings: s1vave — 8-voice virtual analog tweak synth for m-vave fm-1
1. classic sh-101 voice architecture & tweak innovations
option 1: quick install via python recommended
